name: just
description: Modern command runner and task automation tool - simpler make alternative with backwards compatibility promise and cross-platform support

just.description: Command runner for project-specific tasks with make-inspired syntax - no .PHONY recipes needed, works from any subdirectory, never breaking backwards compatibility
just.usage:
just # Run default recipe
just --list # Show available recipes
just build # Run build recipe
just test --verbose # Run test recipe with arguments
just --working-directory /path/to/project build # Run from specific directory
